positiveOperationAudit.finding: The shortlist contains the subordinate escape-html mechanic. Its public candidates do not supply the optional quote behavior and length metadata as a complete callable contract.

The snapshot includes the partially installed python-textwrap identity, marked NON_CONFORMANT, and three records for its same binding. The pilot accepts text and width. The full proposal has additional TextWrapper options. Multiple records for one binding do not establish a runnable composition.
